fields.description: Marina Place 2 is the second residential tower in Emaar’s Marina Place collection at Rashid Yachts & Marina. One-, two- and three-bedroom apartments sit alongside three two-level townhouses. Its own layouts differ from Marina Place 1: terrace sizes, apartment totals and the townhouse footprint should be compared against the Phase 2 plans.

overview: The shared brochure places Marina Place around a planted podium with spaces for exercise, children and informal gatherings. Glazing and balconies connect homes to the surrounding neighbourhood. The development’s waterside setting is part of the proposition, but the outlook, daylight and privacy of each apartment depend on its position.
research.locationNote: Marina Place 2 belongs to Rashid Yachts & Marina in Mina Rashid, Dubai. Emaar identifies the QE2 Hotel and connections to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport. Marina services, promenade destinations and other community attractions are not private facilities belonging to an individual home.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 2.08m. Phase 2’s launch sheet starts one/two/three-bedroom apartments at AED 2.08m/3.08m/4.3m and three-bedroom townhouses at AED 8.95m. These are launch references, not a current stock list.
research.paymentNote: The phase-specific launch document sets eight payments of 10%, including booking, followed by 20% at estimated completion. Its construction milestones and dates are historical terms; confirm the schedule offered for a current purchase.
research.handoverNote: December 2028 is the launch completion estimate and the date reported by Property Finder. It remains subject to the sale agreement and construction progress.

facts.label: Phase 2 launch mix
facts.value: 81 one-bedroom, 74 two-bedroom and 21 three-bedroom apartments, plus three townhouses: 179 homes in the launch sheet, not remaining stock.

facts.label: Townhouse 03
facts.value: Its 2,557.08 sq ft total includes 2,162.58 sq ft suite and 394.50 sq ft outdoor space. Bedrooms are above the living level, with a maid’s room, laundry and storage below.

facts.label: Three-bedroom Type 2
facts.value: The plan includes a study, laundry, walk-in wardrobe and two balconies; its published total is 1,744.19 sq ft.

facts.label: Published finish palette
facts.value: The Phase 2 material board shows pale flooring and wall finishes, wood-toned joinery, joinery glass and a veined countertop/backsplash sample. It is a design palette, not a signed specification or confirmation of suppliers.

unresolved: The launch sheet starts one-bedroom homes at 799 sq ft and three-bedroom homes at 1,717 sq ft; the reviewed plan pack starts at 801.16 and 1,718.24 sq ft respectively. Confirm the selected unit’s registered area.
Property Finder reports a later sales-start date than the November 2024 launch sheet and shows a historical progress percentage. Neither is used as a current construction-status claim.
Final material brands, appliances, furnishing, parking entitlements, fees, live inventory and contractual dates require confirmation.
